title: Hyphens, semicolons and capitals typed in a line are carried as written
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154718 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154718 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "A/C - Recharge"), Description (for example "leak; slow") and the tech story (for example "topped up - dye added; retest").
  • {Work-order-1} has been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  7. Click an empty cell, type =LEN( then click that ItemDescription cell, type ) and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the cell reads exactly the three values as typed, joined by " - " (with the example values "A/C - Recharge - leak; slow - topped up - dye added; retest"): the hyphens and semicolons inside the values are kept, the capitals are kept, and nothing is put in quotes or marked with extra characters such as a backslash.
  • Step 7: with the example values the number is 59 (14 + 3 + 10 + 3 + 29 = 59): nothing was added or removed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R8, S3-R9, S3-R9a, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (Awkward inputs), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-012; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R8: “The values themselves are unchanged. Nothing is trimmed, truncated, re-cased or escaped that is not trimmed, truncated, re-cased or escaped today, other than the shortening described in S3-R7.”
  • S3-R9: “A title, a description or a narrative that itself contains a hyphen, including a spaced hyphen, is carried as written. The separator is not escaped and the text is not quoted, so a reader cannot always tell our separator from theirs. This is accepted deliberately: the alternative is printing a field name to mark the join, which is the thing being removed.”
  • S3-R9a: “A semicolon typed inside any of the three values is ordinary punctuation and is carried through untouched. It was ambiguous only while the semicolon was the separator.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given a description containing a typed semicolon, then the semicolon is carried through unchanged.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given a title or description containing a spaced hyphen, then it is carried as written and nothing is escaped or quoted.”
